scope_limits: Tiny datasets; no measured multi-physical-partition fan-out, hot-partition throttling, or cross-region consistency semantics.
Provisioned accounts defaulted to Strong; baseline clients overrode reads to Session. Serverless defaulted to Session.
One shared 400 RU/s database per provisioned account; no autoscale, extra region, zone redundancy, private endpoint or diagnostic workspace.
Charges represent observed response headers, not a final Azure invoice. Metadata calls without the measurement hook are not included in the response totals.

runs.collection_note: Data operations completed. The SDK called the database-deletion hook with one argument; the collector expected two. The delete reached the hook after the service operation, but the collector did not finish its post-delete inventory check. Per-response samples were checkpointed before this error.
Collector completed, including empty-database inventory verification after deletion.

result.document_size_note: Compact JSON request body bytes; server metadata adds storage.

runs.collection_note: Data operations and database deletion completed. The empty-database assertion passed, then final reporting failed because this synchronous SDK version has no public close() method. The checkpoint contains all measured responses, including database deletion.

earlier_attempts: The initial free-tier pilot collected matching per-operation charges, then reporting failed on len(ItemPaged) while listing feed ranges. It was replaced by the completed free-tier run included here. Its account and two unused accounts were deleted.
A free-tier retry was rejected while the original free-tier account was still Deleting. It created no accounts and allocated no throughput.
The first serverless account in the manual/free attempts never received a database. Only the serverless result included here had a measured workload.

cost_estimate.note: Two full paid capacity hours are an allowance, not observed billing. Only one paid database was allocated throughput; other paid account shells had none. Free-tier databases used 400 RU/s and tiny storage. Azure cost records can be delayed; this estimate is not a spending cutoff.

billing_observation.scope: Only the seven experiment account resource IDs
billing_observation.interpretation: No posted rows at query time. This is not evidence of a zero final bill; cost ingestion can lag.
